web.hero.title:
Agents do the work.
You make the decisions.
web.hero.body: Polaris turns any goal into strategies that move in parallel. Background agents research and execute, then bring back only the decisions that need your judgment.
web.agents.title: Works with the agent you already use.
web.agents.body: Connect with the client’s own sign-in. No API keys and no Polaris account.
web.decide.title: Decisions come to you
web.decide.body: Background agents turn what they find into decision cards: one question, the facts that matter and a recommendation. Make the call, and the work moves on.
web.decide.oneBody: Each card keeps only the facts that change the answer.
web.decide.recBody: Agents suggest an option and explain why. Choose another or write your own.
web.decide.handoffBody: The main agent applies your choice and hands the next steps to background agents.
web.decide.historyBody: Confirmed decisions stay with their strategy, newest first.
web.plan.title: Set the direction together
web.plan.body: The main agent helps you choose a goal, define success and compare complementary strategies. Nothing is saved until you adopt it.
web.plan.growBody: Agents study what worked for goals like yours and propose new paths. Say yes, and a new column starts working.
web.plan.prepareBody: When a strategy has nothing pending, an agent researches the next decisions worth your time, up to three at once.
web.parallel.title: Every goal, moving at once
web.parallel.lead: A product, a language, a race.
web.parallel.body: Each goal gets its own board and each strategy its own column. Up to five background agents work at the same time.
web.parallel.activityBody: Open any background task to see what it is doing. Finished work clears itself.
web.parallel.scheduleBody: Work that has to wait, like checking for a reply tomorrow, runs on schedule.
web.parallel.recoveryBody: After a restart, Polaris restores pending work and checks uncertain results before continuing.
web.parallel.knowledgeBody: Facts agents learn stay available across tasks. Inspect and correct them anytime.
web.local.title: Open source, on your Mac
web.local.body: Goals, decisions, conversations and knowledge are stored on your Mac. There is no Polaris account and no Polaris cloud.
web.local.providerBody: Polaris uses the sign-in of the client you connect. Your provider processes the context each task sends and applies its own usage limits.
web.local.boundaryBody: Agents run with broad access to your files, commands and connected tools. Decision cards record your approval; they are not a sandbox.
web.start.title: Set your first goal
web.start.body: Download Polaris, then install and sign in to Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI. Tell the main agent what you want to move forward.
web.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
web.faq.freeA: Yes. Polaris is open source under AGPL-3.0, with no paid edition and no Polaris account. Agents run through your own Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI sign-in, so that provider’s plans and usage limits apply.
web.faq.versionA: Polaris {{version}} is a development preview, so features and the interface may still change. Every version is listed on the GitHub releases page.
web.faq.trustQ: How can I check the download?
web.faq.trustA: Each release is built by GitHub Actions from the tagged source, signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. SHA-256 checksums are published with every release.
web.faq.clientsA: Install and sign in to one of these clients, then connect it in Polaris. Polaris checks the installed version when it connects.
web.faq.platformQ: Does it run on Windows or Linux?
web.faq.platformA: No. Polaris runs on macOS 15 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
web.faq.updateA: Download the latest version and drag it into Applications to replace the old one. Your workspace stays where it is, and Polaris makes a verified backup before any database upgrade.
web.faq.closedQ: Does it keep working when I close the window?
web.faq.closedA: Yes. Closing the window keeps Polaris running. Quitting the app, sleep or shutdown stops local work. When Polaris starts again, it restores pending work, and a missed schedule runs only its latest occurrence.

web.localBody: Goals, constraints and preferences, strategies, decisions and history are stored on your device and are not automatically synced to the cloud.
web.agentBody: Using an Agent sends the messages, relevant business context and tool results needed for the request to the selected AI platform. Its own terms apply. Disconnecting does not delete local history.
web.choicesBody: You can stop tasks, disconnect AI platforms and export your documents. Uninstalling the app does not automatically remove the local workspace.
web.scopeBody: Polaris provides planning support, a local decision board and built-in Agent execution. Third-party AI services have their own account, permission and usage requirements.
web.backupBody: You are responsible for confirming your decisions and their consequences, and for backing up important data. Third-party service availability and permissions are managed by the respective platforms.
web.siteBody: This website has no accounts or analytics. It sets one cookie to remember your language. Vercel, which hosts the site, processes request data such as your IP address to deliver pages. Downloads and source code come from GitHub under its own privacy terms.
web.licenseBody: The Polaris app and its source code are free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0. As the license states, they come without warranty to the extent permitted by law.
web.privacyContact: Polaris is operated by {{operator}}. For privacy questions or requests, email {{email}}.
web.termsContact: Polaris is operated by {{operator}}. For questions about these terms, email {{email}}.
